subject.title: fix(agents): skip model-override repair and visibility gate for locked sessions

question: Is modelSelectionLocked alone the approved trusted-owner invariant for bypassing model visibility and normalization across every durable plugin session?
rationale: The patch correctly avoids mutating locked state, but it broadens the exemption beyond harness-shaped sessions and therefore changes the provider/model routing boundary for all present and future lock writers.

options.title: Approve the lock invariant
options.body: Treat every valid modelSelectionLocked session as plugin-owned routing state, retain the symmetric exemptions, and merge after rebase and exact-head validation.

options.title: Require stronger ownership proof
options.body: Narrow the exemption to a validated harness or plugin owner identifier if ordinary, imported, or externally editable session entries can carry the lock flag.

recommendation.title: Approve the lock invariant
recommendation.body: Treat every valid modelSelectionLocked session as plugin-owned routing state, retain the symmetric exemptions, and merge after rebase and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is in the central agent-command and CLI-session routing surface where the permanent lock invariant must be owned.
